## Checklist

- [ ] Every commit is signed off with `git commit -s` ([Developer Certificate of Origin](https://github.com/ArmandoHerra/pdf-tooling/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#developer-certificate-of-origin); there is no CLA).
- [ ] `make ci` passes locally. See [what must be green before a merge](https://github.com/ArmandoHerra/pdf-tooling/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#what-must-be-green-before-a-merge).
- [ ] If this implements a planned specification, its `changelog.md` entry is in the same commit, directly below the anchor.
- [ ] The change respects [what a change must not do](https://github.com/ArmandoHerra/pdf-tooling/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#what-a-change-must-not-do).
- [ ] No real or private document was added to the repository.
